description: Implementation of BN_CTX functions for managing big number contexts in OpenSSL, including memory management and stack operations.

methods.name: BN_CTX_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a BN_CTX structure.

methods.name: BN_CTX_start
methods.description: Marks the start of a new temporary context scope.

methods.name: BN_CTX_get
methods.description: Retrieves a BIGNUM from the context, managing internal stack.

methods.name: BN_CTX_end
methods.description: Ends a temporary context scope, restoring previous state.
